No Appliances Direct offers: its washing machine category pages carried no products in their HTML (the grid is filled by script), so no model or price could be read.

No Russell Hobbs models: the mda.russellhobbs.com laundry listing URLs tried returned HTTP 404, and no retailer listing carrying them could be read.
No Fisher & Paykel models: the two fisherpaykel.com/uk washing machine category pages tried contain no product tiles or prices in their HTML.

Beko, Blomberg, Candy, Haier, Hoover, Montpellier, Samsung and LG models come from Euronics listing pages (nine washing machines also from Marks Electrical) because the makers' own UK pages were not usable: beko.co.uk's listing showed no prices, the samsung.com/uk and lg.com/uk listings returned no products to the fetch, and the other makers' sites were not read; EPREL numbers were therefore read only for Hotpoint and eprel is null for every other brand.
Marks Electrical's washing machine listing shows 12 of 189 products per page, so only its first listing page and landing page were read, and its dryers and dishwashers were not read.

Euronics and Marks Electrical show one price per model unless Euronics prints a 'Was' price; the Was price is recorded where shown, and otherwise the single price shown is recorded because the page does not say whether it is a sale price.
Samsung WW11DG6B25LBU1: Euronics titles it 9kg although the model number denotes 11kg, so capacityKg is null.
LG WT1210WWF and WT1210BBTN1 (LG WashTower stacks) and Haier CLC108-GNU1-UK (10kg wash and 8kg dry at 1699.99, which looks like a stacked tower) were skipped as pairs sold as one listing.

placeSettings is null for Hotpoint HP2FFC14BN6BUK and H7IB16M6L UK (the page states no place-settings figure), for Montpellier MDWC1496W and for LG DF355FP (their Euronics titles state none).
